title: Independent Conclusion Review

claim_1.statement: H-3 (Macro Regime) shows IC improvement from +0.027 to +0.091
caveats: Improvement is real in magnitude but bootstrap p-values may be unreliable (some experiments show p=0.000 which is suspicious)
Lasso produces IC=0.000 in non-macro experiments, suggesting the lasso implementation may have issues
The improvement could be driven by the macro features acting as a regime filter rather than a predictive signal
No walk-forward validation — the improvement is on a single fixed test period (2022-2026)

claim_2.evidence: IC positive on both ENV-050 (+0.091 ridge, +0.108 lasso) and ENV-100 (+0.132 ridge, +0.146 lasso). Sign consistent across model families for ridge.

claim_3.evidence: Raw p-values: ridge=0.063, lasso=0.028 on ENV-050. After Holm correction: not significant at 0.05. After BH correction: lasso borderline (0.056). On ENV-100: ridge p=0.0001, lasso p=0.0000 — significant before correction.

claim_4.reasoning: While H-3 shows improvement, the evidence is preliminary: (a) single test period, (b) no walk-forward, (c) no portfolio validation, (d) lasso issues in other experiments, (e) the improvement could be overfitting to the specific macro environment of 2022-2026.

rejected_statements: Signal discovered — REJECTED. Evidence suggests a candidate relationship requiring further replication.
Profitable strategy found — REJECTED. No portfolio economics tested.
Predictive model validated — REJECTED. Only RESEARCH status warranted.
preferred_language: Evidence suggests a candidate relationship (H-3 macro regime conditioning) requiring further replication. The IC improvement is economically meaningful in magnitude but statistically borderline after multiple-testing correction. No economic validation has been performed.

comparison_to_prior_phases.phase_12_9c: Prior: max IC 0.0429 (fundamentals). Now: H-3 IC 0.091-0.146. Improvement is larger but still below 0.05 academic threshold for IC (though 0.09-0.15 is above 0.05).
comparison_to_prior_phases.phase_13c: Prior: 'No convincing, robust predictive relationship.' Now: Evidence suggests a candidate relationship requiring further replication. The null has not been overturned but a promising direction has been identified.
comparison_to_prior_phases.phase_14: Prior: 0 models promoted. Now: 0 models promoted. H-3 is RESEARCH_ONLY — no evidence sufficient for VALIDATED status.
